audit.why: 52.31% over 627 games. You win the first three levels and lose the scaling — the chart and the prose already agree, and this page is one of the better-written in the slice.
Spikes are placed right, including the unusual and correct choice of giving Steadfast Presence its own row — it genuinely is the matchup. Timings unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock is called a knockup in four places.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' It is a slow and a delayed detonation, with no displacement in it at all. That changes what you do about it: a knockup would cancel your Aegis Assault and force you to pre-empt it, whereas a delayed ground zone is something you simply walk out of before it explodes. The page has you bracing against a displacement that does not exist while the two abilities that genuinely displace you — Heroic Charge and Keeper's Verdict — get less attention.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock restated as a slowing zone that detonates on a delay, with walking out of it as the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict is described only as something that 'boots you out of any fight'. That it is a channel is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot: 'Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.' A channel that Shield Vault — point-and-click, undodgeable, 600 range — cancels outright. That is the single best line available in this matchup and it is on neither layer: her 140s game-deciding ultimate is answered by a 13s stun you cannot miss. The page instead treats the ult as an unavoidable disengage. Also missing: Heroic Charge's wall-pin stun is hard CC and cancels your Aegis Assault, so bracing near terrain is the losing option.
audit.corrected: The Shield Vault cancel on Keeper's Verdict written into late and the level-6 spike; the Heroic Charge channel cancel into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says to bait her W without saying what baiting it buys.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s. At rank 1 that is twenty seconds — the longest basic cooldown in the matchup and far longer than your Shield Vault's 13s. Baiting it does not open a small window, it opens one long enough to engage twice. Heroic Charge is 14s down to 10s and Keeper's Verdict 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The 20s written into the Steadfast Presence spike and early.

edits.before: Grand Starfall lets you leave the lane and snowball a side — Poppy can't roam with you, so cash your early lead across the map.
edits.after: Grand Starfall lets you leave and snowball a side — and note Keeper's Verdict is a channel your Shield Vault cancels outright.

edits.before: Her W is the whole matchup: it slows and her active stops your W-Vault dash mid-flight, so bait it before you commit your engage.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence is the matchup: its active stops Shield Vault mid-flight, and at 20s a baited one buys two engages.

edits.before: Poppy stabilizes with tank stats and her Q knockup; your kill pressure dips so it's even on skill and her W timing.
edits.after: Poppy stabilises with tank stats and Hammer Shock zoning; it comes down to skill and Steadfast Presence timing.

edits.before: Poppy is a slow, immobile level 1 and you are one of the strongest — your point-and-click W stun plus an empowered Q chunks her before she has any answer. The trap is her W: its active stops your Shield Vault dash dead in the air, so don't open with W into a held W or you eat a free trade. Bait it with a Q poke or a fake step-in first, then W-Q all-in at 2-3 when you have your full combo and she has nothing back. Watch the wall behind you — her E pins you for a stun if you fight with your back to terrain.
edits.after: Poppy is a slow, immobile level 1 and you are one of the strongest — point-and-click Shield Vault plus an empowered Comet Spear chunks her before she has any answer. The trap is Steadfast Presence: its active stops Shield Vault dead in the air, so never open into a held one. It is 20s at rank 1, longer than your own stun, so baiting it with a fake step-in buys you two engages rather than one. Then all-in at 2-3 with the full combo. Watch the wall behind you: Heroic Charge pins you into terrain for a stun that also cancels Aegis Assault.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where she stabilizes — your raw kill pressure dips as she gets tank stats and her Q knockup plus E wall-pin start to hurt. Keep poking with the long-thrown empowered Q and use Aegis Assault (E) to block her Q knockup when she steps up. At 6 your real value isn't the 1v1, it's Grand Starfall — leave lane and gank a side before she comes online, because she can't roam with you and you out-tempo her on the map.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 she stabilises — tank stats, and Hammer Shock's slowing zone plus the Heroic Charge wall-pin start to hurt. Hammer Shock does not knock you up; it detonates after a delay, so walk out rather than bracing. Do not hold Aegis Assault near terrain either — the wall-pin stun cancels the channel. At 6 your value is Grand Starfall, not the 1v1: leave and gank a side, because she cannot roam with you.

edits.before: This is where you lose. Poppy with two tank items walls every all-in with E, outlasts your front-loaded burst, and her R can boot you out of any fight you start. Your damage flatlines while she just gets harder to kill. Don't try to solo her at three items — your win condition was banked in the first ten minutes, so play around the lead you made and let your team handle her in the 5v5.
edits.after: This is where you lose the duel — but not the ult. Keeper's Verdict is a CHANNEL, and Shield Vault is point-and-click on 13s, so you cancel her 140s teamfight winner with a button she cannot dodge. Hold it for that. Otherwise two tank items outlast your burst and your damage flatlines, so don't solo her at three items; play the lead you banked in the first ten minutes.

notes: THE BEST LINE IN THIS MATCHUP WAS MISSING FROM BOTH LAYERS: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — Riot's text is 'Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away' — and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun on 13s that cancels it outright. Her 140-second, teamfight-deciding ultimate is answered by a button you cannot miss, and the page instead described the ult as an unavoidable disengage. Correction: Hammer Shock was called a knockup four times. It is 'a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay' with no displacement at all, which changes the response from bracing to walking out. Also added Heroic Charge's wall-pin stun cancelling your Aegis Assault, so bracing with your back to terrain is the losing choice, and Steadfast Presence's real cost — 20s at rank 1, longer than your own Shield Vault, so a baited one is worth two engages. This page had the hardest part right already: it correctly identifies Steadfast Presence's active as the dash-stopper, which most pages in this slice would have attributed to the wrong ability. Note that champ-data/_kits/poppy.json tags Hammer Shock with 'grounding'; nothing in Riot's description supports that and I did not write it.
